answer: Sybil resistance here is an explicit capital-and-time tax. An identity may attest or grade only after locking spendable POA for several epochs and keeping a continuous, peer-attested work river of answers and countersignatures. A gale of freshly minted keys can appear on the horizon overnight, but they stay ineligible until the lock matures and that work trail is long enough that buying the history costs more than the expected emission.
